From Sept. 4–9, {N}power® members can enjoy savings of up to 51% on premium-quality products at Natural Grocers®.


{N}power members can save up to 51% off end-of-summer favorites at Natural Grocers locations nationwide


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Aug. 28, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Natural Grocers®, the nation's largest family-operated natural and organic grocery retailer, is helping customers stock up for the unofficial end of summer with its[Even More AffordableSM Labor Day Deals](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=2510506082&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Flabor-day-deals%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dnational-event-npower-EMA-labor-day-deals-2026&a=Even+More+AffordableSM%C2%A0Labor+Day+Deals) . From Sept. 4–9, {N}power® members can enjoy savings of up to 51% on premium-quality products that will make those last bits of summer last in a delicious, affordable way.\[i\]


**LABOR DAY DEALS AT NATURAL GROCERS** **Sept. 4–9:** {N}power members can save up to 51% on items such as:


- Force of Nature Grass Fed AncestralTM Blend Regenerative Ground Beef ($10.99/16 oz) or Actual Veggies® Veggie Burgers ($4.79/12 oz package).
- Late July® Organic Restaurant-Style Tortilla Chips ($2.99/10 oz). These thin and crispy chips are made with real organic whole ground corn.
- Muir Glen Organic Salsas ($3.89/16 oz). Vine-ripened, organic tomatoes picked at the peak of flavor, offer a traditional tomato taste and bright, bold flavors with every bite.
- GT's Living Foods Agua De KefirTM ($1.79 each). Born from prickly pear cactus, Agua de Kefir offers non-dairy, cultured hydration with a lighter taste than kombucha.


**MORE {N}POWER MEMBER PERKS**


- [Sept. 17–19](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=845262341&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Forganic-month%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dnational-event-EMA-organic-month-deals-2026&a=Sept.+17%E2%80%9319) **:** In celebration of Organic Month, {N}power members can enjoy additional savings and perks that reflect the company's commitment to organic practices.\[ii\]
- **Through Sept. 30:** Natural Grocers will offer {N}power members Even More AffordableSM prices on over 1,000 items like Contented Hen® Free-Range Brown Eggs ($2.99/dozen, limit 2), Thousand HillsTM 100% Grass-Fed 80/20 Ground Beef ($7.99/16 oz), Natural Grocers® Brand Organic Whole Milk Yogurts ($4.49/32 oz) and more.\[iii\]
- **Through Sept. 30:** {N}power members can feed up to four people for under $17 with a Natural Grocers good4u® Grilled Chicken and Veggies Meal Deal, featuring Mary's® Organic Whole Chicken and 100% certified organic yellow squash, zucchini and red onions.\[iv\] Visit[naturalgrocers.com/mealdeals](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=485514093&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fmealdeals&a=naturalgrocers.com%2Fmealdeals) for all current meal deal offerings.


*Not an {N}power member? Not a problem! Signing up is quick, easy and free. Customers who join will receive a $2 reward off their next purchase, plus over $12 in coupons, during their first month:*[www.naturalgrocers.com/npower](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=237220617&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower&a=www.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower) *.*


**LUSCIOUS LABOR DAY RECIPES** To ensure a tasty three-day weekend, Natural Grocers is featuring a fresh collection of[seasonally appropriate recipes](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=834553405&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Frecipe-finder%3Fsort_by%3Dcreated%26sort_order%3DDESC%26search_api_fulltext%3Dearly%2Bfall&a=seasonally+appropriate+recipes) . From a savory[Roasted Grape Tart](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=3148467719&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Frecipe%2Froasted-grape-tart%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dedu-recipe-aug-2026&a=Roasted+Grape+Tart) to a[Smoked Salmon Salad](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=3999079616&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Frecipe%2Feverything-bagel-smoked-salmon-salad&a=Smoked+Salmon+Salad) , there's something for everyone, regardless of dietary preference.

**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE**
Founded in 1955, Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. ([NYSE: NGVC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=305763751&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=NYSE%3A%C2%A0NGVC) ) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=2355249192&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 174 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4758749-1&h=2450234021&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com) for more information and store locations.
